name: Sixty Six
summary: Two-player trick-taking game with a 24-card deck where points from cards, marriages and last trick race to 66.
rules_text: Use A(K high?) A,10,K,Q,J,9 in four suits, 24 cards. Deal 6 each in two rounds of 3. Turn next card as trump, remaining 11 cards form stock with trump partially visible. Non-dealer leads. Suit need not be followed while stock exists; trick won by higher of led suit or trump. Winner draws top of stock, opponent draws next, winner leads. Nine of trumps may be exchanged for face-up trump after winning a trick. A marriage is K+Q of same suit shown and one led: 40 in trumps, 20 otherwise, scores only after its owner wins a trick. Either player on lead may close by turning trump down; no more draws and last trick is not 10. After stock gone, must follow suit if possible. Points: A 11, Ten 10, K 4, Q 3, J 2, last trick 10 plus marriages. First to announce 66+ stops hand.
rating_reason: Specific 2p trick-taking 66-point game, strategic hidden hands.
